title: lesquerella kingii subsp. diversifolia
intro: Lesquerella kingii subsp. diversifolia, commonly known as a type of mustard plant, is a species within the Brassicaceae family. It has been used in traditional medicine due to its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Lesquerella kingii subsp. diversifolia include its ability to reduce inflammation and improve wound healing. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include glucosinolates, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
